# Biophilic Design

> A comprehensive resource exploring how to integrate nature into built environments for improved wellness, productivity, and sustainability.

Biophilic Design focuses on the principles and applications of bringing natural elements into architectural and interior spaces. The site covers research-backed benefits of nature-based design across healthcare, workplace, and urban settings, featuring insights from thought leaders like Edward O. Wilson and partnerships with organizations like the International Biophilic Product Association.

## Key Topics

- Biophilic design
- Biophilia hypothesis
- Built environment
- Nature-based design
- Workplace design
